about_the_game:
Pixel Combat Shooter - a first-person shooter where you fight for survival in a house that has become the last stronghold of humanity. Zombies from different eras and dimensions break through time portals. Build defenses, upgrade weapons, explore secrets, and try to stop the apocalypse.

NOW ON STEAM

For only $4.99, Pixel Combat Shooter instantly throws you into the action — jump straight into the fight! When you buy the game, you get the DLC Starter Pack for free — a starter kit with everything you need and more. Inside, you’ll find deadly weapons, grenades, valuable trophies, upgrade resources, and the exclusive Gabeman skin, available only to pack owners. No ads — just you, your weapons, and endless waves of the undead.

SURVIVAL UNDER SIEGE

Defend your house from endless waves of zombies. Board up doors, find escape routes, retreat, and counterattack — your house turns into a fortress, and only you can decide how long it will last.

CLASSIC FPS GAMEPLAY

First-person shooting until the last bullet. An enormous arsenal — from machetes to flamethrowers. And if you can’t find what you like, build your own weapon from scrap. Customize and upgrade every gun — this is serious business.

CRAFTING AND UPGRADES

Create weapons and ammo, unlock unique skins, and turn your gun into something that even zombies will fear.

BATTLES WITH UNIQUE BOSSES

Not all the dead are equally dangerous. From time to time, something stronger will emerge, and you’ll have to give it your all to survive. Study weaknesses and adapt your tactics.

PIXEL ATMOSPHERE

Old-school FPS-style graphics create a unique atmosphere. Bright 3D locations, visual effects, and a nostalgic style make the game memorable and instantly recognizable.

SECRETS AND EXPLORATION

Each location is filled with hidden rooms and unexpected finds. Explore the levels, uncover secrets, gather resources — and don’t miss out on any details of the time machine.

Can you survive until the end, gather all the parts of the device, and change the course of history? Or will you remain forever trapped among the mindless dead?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 360
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Pixel Combat Shooter is a pixel shooter where you have to fight for survival in a world plagued by zombie apocalypse. Defend your home from waves of zombies, build a time machine and fight unique bosses. Crafting, upgrades and a nostalgic atmosphere.
